## 1 Tax_Revenue Data Preparation

### 1.1 Tax Loading


```{r}
# 处理 11-16 年数据：统一字段名与 ID 类型 (Character)
tax_11to16 <- read_csv("/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/1209new/tax2011_2016.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Year = year, Mon = month,
    across(c(TaxpayerNumber, LocationNumber, LocationZip), as.character),
    Taxpayer_Number = TaxpayerNumber, Taxpayer_Name = TaxpayerName, Taxpayer_Address = TaxpayerAddress,
    Location_Number = LocationNumber, Location_Name = LocationName, Location_Address = LocationAddress, 
    Location_City = LocationCity, Location_Zip = LocationZip, 
    Unit_Capacity = UnitCapacity, Total_Room_Receipts = TotalRoomReceipts, Taxable_Receipts = TaxableReceipts
  ) |>
  select(Year, Mon, Taxpayer_Number, Taxpayer_Name, Taxpayer_Address, Location_Number, Location_Name, Location_Address, Location_City, Location_Zip, Unit_Capacity, Total_Room_Receipts, Taxable_Receipts)

#  处理 17-23 年数据：从 Obligation_End_Date 解析日期
root <- "/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/1209new/Month_Revenue"
col_names <- c("Taxpayer_Number", "Taxpayer_Name", "Taxpayer_Address", "Taxpayer_City", "Taxpayer_State", "Taxpayer_Zip", "Taxpayer_County", "Taxpayer_Phone", "Location_Number", "Location_Name", "Location_Address", "Location_City", "Location_State", "Location_Zip", "Location_County", "Location_Phone", "Unit_Capacity", "Responsibility_Begin_Date", "Responsibility_End_Date", "Obligation_End_Date", "Filer_Type", "Total_Room_Receipts", "Taxable_Receipts")

# 批量读取并强制所有列为字符型，防止合并报错
subdirs <- list.dirs(root, recursive = FALSE) |> str_subset("HOT\\d{4}$")
df_hot <- map_df(subdirs, ~ {
  f <- file.path(.x, paste0(basename(.x), ".CSV"))
  if (file.exists(f)) read_csv(f, col_names = col_names, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) else NULL
})

df_hotel <- map_df(c("2017", "2018", "2019"), ~ {
  f <- list.files(file.path(root, paste0("HOTEL", substr(.x, 3, 4))), pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) > 0) read_csv(f[1], col_names = col_names, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) else NULL
})

# 转换类型并解析日期 (YYYYMMDD)
tax_17to23 <- bind_rows(df_hot, df_hotel) |>
  filter(Filer_Type == "50") |>
  mutate(
    d_num = as.numeric(Obligation_End_Date),
    Year = as.integer(d_num %/% 10000),
    Mon  = as.integer((d_num %% 10000) %/% 100),
    Unit_Capacity = as.numeric(Unit_Capacity),
    Total_Room_Receipts = as.numeric(Total_Room_Receipts)
  ) |>
  select(Year, Mon, Taxpayer_Number, Taxpayer_Name, Taxpayer_Address, Location_Number, Location_Name, Location_Address, Location_City, Location_Zip, Unit_Capacity, Total_Room_Receipts)

# 合并全集并去重
tax_all <- bind_rows(tax_11to16, tax_17to23) |>
  arrange(Location_City, Location_Name, Location_Address, Year, Mon) |>
  group_by(Location_City, Location_Name, Location_Address, Year, Mon) |>
  filter(n() == 1) |> # 剔除重复申报
  ungroup() |>
  filter(Unit_Capacity >= 1)

# 计算 RevPAR 与 竞争对手均值 (Data.table 高速处理)
dt <- as.data.table(tax_all)
dt[, DaysInMonth := days_in_month(as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", Year, Mon)))]

# 聚合计算
revenue_all <- dt[, .(
  # 必须在这里显式定义 Unit_Capacity，否则结果表里没这一列
  Unit_Capacity  = Unit_Capacity, 
  Total_Receipts = sum(Total_Room_Receipts, na.rm = TRUE),
  # 确保 RevPAR 计算逻辑完整（除以天数）
  RevPAR = sum(Total_Room_Receipts, na.rm = TRUE) / (Unit_Capacity * first(DaysInMonth))
), by = .(Location_Zip, Location_Name, Location_Address, Year, Mon)]

# 现在这里就不会报错了
revenue_all_clean <- revenue_all[RevPAR<10000]

revenue_all_clean[, `:=`(
  hotel_number = .N,
  avg_com_RevPAR = {
    if (.N <= 1) NA_real_
    else (sum(RevPAR, na.rm = TRUE) - RevPAR) / (.N - 1)
  }
), by = .(Location_Zip, Year, Mon)]

# 处理孤立点
revenue_all_clean[hotel_number <= 1, avg_com_RevPAR := NA_real_]

# 清理内存：删除所有中间过程变量

rm(tax_11to16, tax_17to23, df_hot, df_hotel, dt, subdirs, root, col_names)
```


```{r}
revenue_tp_all <- inner_join(revenue_all_clean, allmatched |> select(HotelID, CityID, CityName, Zip, LocationAddress, LocationName), by=c("Location_Name"="LocationName","Location_Address"="LocationAddress")) |>
  group_by(HotelID, Year, Mon) |>
  mutate(num = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # 找出有任意 num > 1 的 HotelID
  group_by(HotelID) |>
  mutate(has_dup = any(num > 1)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # 只保留没有重复的酒店
  filter(!has_dup) |>
  filter(avg_com_RevPAR>0) |>
  select(-num, -has_dup)
```

```{r}
library(progress)

# 准备目标 ID
target_ids <- valid_match_review$ReviewID
file_path <- "/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/1209new/TP_texas_data/reviews_texas_en_doc2vec200_joined.csv"

# 估算行数以设置进度条
# 使用系统命令快速获取行数 (Mac/Linux)
total_lines <- as.numeric(system(paste("wc -l <", file_path), intern = TRUE))
pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "  读取中 [:bar] :percent 耗时: :elapsedfull",
  total = total_lines, clear = FALSE, width = 60
)

# 定义回调函数：每次读取一块数据时执行的操作
filter_chunk <- function(chunk, pos) {
  # 更新进度条
  pb$tick(nrow(chunk))
  
  # 执行筛选和重命名
  chunk |>
    filter(ReviewID %in% target_ids) |>
    rename(
      ReviewID              = ReviewID,
      Review_Published_Date = ReviewDate
    )
}

# 执行分块读取
review_vector_filtered <- read_csv_chunked(
  file_path,
  callback = DataFrameCallback$new(filter_chunk),
  chunk_size = 50000,      # 每次读 5w 行，根据内存调整
  col_types = cols(.default = "c"), # 保持全字符型
  progress = FALSE         # 关闭自带进度条，使用我们自定义的
)

# 清理
rm(target_ids, pb, filter_chunk, total_lines,file_path)
```

#### 2.2 month and before review

```{r}
valid_match_review <- read_csv("/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/1209new/TP_texas_data/valid_match_review0118.csv")
```

```{r}
review_content <- review_vector_filtered |>
  mutate(
    RatingDate = as.Date(Review_Published_Date),
    Rating = ReviewRating
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-Review_Published_Date, -ReviewRating)

review_content <- review_content |>
  rename_with(
    .fn = ~ str_replace(.x, "^vector_(\\d+)$", "V\\1"),
    .cols = starts_with("vector_")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    AvgRatingStarsThisUser = Rating
  ) |>
  arrange(HotelID, RatingDate, ReviewID) |>
  select(ReviewID, HotelID, RatingDate, AvgRatingStarsThisUser, V0:V199)

start_date <- min(review_content$RatingDate)
end_date <- max(review_content$RatingDate)

monthly_end_dates <- seq.Date(from = floor_date(start_date, "year"), 
                              to = ceiling_date(end_date, "year") - days(1), 
                              by = "month")

monthly_end_dates <- sapply(monthly_end_dates, function(date) {
  last_day_of_month <- ceiling_date(date, "month") - days(1)
  return(last_day_of_month)
}) |> 
  as.Date()

all_hotel_months <- expand.grid(
  HotelID = as.integer(unique(review_content$HotelID)),
  month_end_dates = monthly_end_dates
) |>
  mutate(
    month_begin_dates = floor_date(month_end_dates, "month")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(HotelID, month_begin_dates, month_end_dates)

review_content <- review_content |>
  arrange(HotelID, RatingDate, ReviewID) |>
  select(ReviewID, HotelID, RatingDate, AvgRatingStarsThisUser, V0:V199)

rm(end_date, monthly_end_dates, start_date)
```

```{r load data}
panel_reviews_combined_10 <- panel_reviews_before10 |>

        x <- .x |>
          mutate(

          )
        y <- .y |>

        bind_rows(x, y)
      }

    recent_volumn = map_int(combined_reviews, nrow),
    recent_rating = map_dbl(
      combined_reviews,
      ~ {
        r <- .x$AvgRatingStarsThisUser
        if (length(r) == 0 || all(is.na(r))) NA_real_
        else mean(r, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    ),
    recent_sd = map_dbl(
      combined_reviews,
      ~ {
        r <- .x$AvgRatingStarsThisUser
        if (length(r) <= 1 || all(is.na(r))) NA_real_
        else sd(r, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(HotelID,month_begin_dates,recent_reviews=combined_reviews,recent_volumn,recent_sd,recent_rating)
```

#### 2.3  Simi Calculate

```{r}
load("/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/Data/balanced_panel_before10.RData")
# load("/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/Data/balanced_panel_before20.RData")
# load("/Users/samxie/Research/ReviewSimi_Sales/Data/balanced_panel_before30.RData")
```


```{r}
calc_sim_safe <- function(mat_input) {
  # 空值检查
  if (is.null(mat_input) || length(mat_input) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mat_num <- suppressWarnings(apply(mat_input, 2, as.numeric))
  # 容错：如果转完不是矩阵（比如变成了向量），强转回矩阵
  if (!is.matrix(mat_num)) {
    mat_num <- matrix(mat_num, nrow = 1)
  }
  # 如果行数小于2，说明只有1条评论，无法计算内部差异，返回NA
  if (nrow(mat_num) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  # 计算相似度
  sim_matrix <- sim2(mat_num, mat_num, method = "cosine")
  diag(sim_matrix) <- NA # 对角线设为NA
  return(mean(sim_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
}

simi_results2 <- balanced_panel_before10 |>
  group_by(HotelID) |>
  arrange(month_begin_dates) |>
  # 先生成滞后期的矩阵数据
  mutate(vector_matrix_lag = lag(vector_matrix)) |>
  # 再计算两者的相似度
  mutate(
    sim_mean_lag = map_dbl(vector_matrix_lag, calc_sim_safe),
    sim_mean     = map_dbl(vector_matrix, calc_sim_safe)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(HotelID, month_begin_dates)
```

```{r}
valid_match_review <- valid_match_review |>
  mutate(
    RatingDate = Review_Published_Date,
    AvgRatingStarsThisUser = Review_Rating
  )

entropy <- function(x) {
  freq <- table(x) / length(x)
  -sum(freq * log2(freq), na.rm = TRUE)
}
inverse_hhi <- function(x) {
  freq <- table(x) / length(x)
  1 / sum(freq^2)
}
review_sd <- valid_match_review |> 
  dplyr::select(HotelID, Year, Mon, RatingDate, AvgRatingStarsThisUser) |> 
  group_by(HotelID, Year, Mon) |> 
  summarise(
    sd_mon = sd(AvgRatingStarsThisUser),
    monvol = n(),
    sd_entropy = entropy(AvgRatingStarsThisUser),
    sd_inverse_HHI = inverse_hhi(AvgRatingStarsThisUser)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(HotelID, Year, Mon) 

rm(entropy, inverse_hhi)
```

```{r}
# 月级别 summarise
valid_match_review_acc <- left_join(valid_match_review_process, revenue_tp_all_bind|>mutate(HotelID=as.character(HotelID))|>select(-from, -CityID)) |>
  mutate(
    year_month = sprintf("%04d-%02d", Year, Mon),
    characters = nchar(Review_Text),
    words = str_count(Review_Text, "\\S+")
  ) |>
  group_by(HotelID, Year, Mon) |>
  arrange(HotelID, Year, Mon, Review_Date) |>
  summarise(
    avg_rating_month = mean(Review_Rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    characters_month = sum(characters, na.rm = TRUE),
    words_month = sum(words, na.rm = TRUE),
    volumn_month = n(),
    RevPAR = mean(RevPAR, na.rm = T),
    avg_com_RevPAR = mean(avg_com_RevPAR, na.rm = T),
    rating_last_5 = mean(tail(Review_Rating, 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    rating_last_10 = mean(tail(Review_Rating, 10), na.rm = TRUE),
    year_month = sprintf("%04d-%02d", first(Year), first(Mon)),
    rating_list = list(Review_Rating),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(HotelID, Year, Mon) |>
  group_by(HotelID) |>
  mutate(
    avg_rating_acc = cummean(avg_rating_month),
    characters_acc = cumsum(characters_month),
    words_acc = cumsum(words_month),
    volumn_acc = cumsum(volumn_month),

    # 累积标准差：合并截至当月的所有 rating
    sd_acc = sapply(seq_along(rating_list), function(i) {
      ratings <- unlist(rating_list[1:i])
      sd(ratings, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
  group_by(HotelID, Year, Mon) |>

  filter(avg_com_RevPAR>0) |>
```
